_comment: LTX-2.5 text-to-video ComfyUI API-format workflow. Derived node-for-node from the OFFICIAL template at github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/video_ltx2_5_t2v.json (fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com). This is the API ('prompt') format ComfyUI's POST /prompt endpoint expects, converted from the UI graph-save format of the official template, which wraps the whole pipeline in a single UI 'subgraph' node (Text to Video (LTX-2.5)); that subgraph has been flattened here into its 42 constituent real nodes (ids taken from the official template) plus the outer SaveVideo node. The subgraph's own ResolutionSelector helper node (id 409 in the source) and the MarkdownNote documentation nodes were UI-only / superseded by direct numeric overrides and were dropped, since they have no class_type executable in API format and are not needed once WIDTH/HEIGHT are injected directly. {{PROMPT}} is substituted into node 376 (PrimitiveStringMultiline 'Prompt'). {{SEED}} into node 339's noise_seed (the low-resolution-pass RandomNoise; the high-resolution pass, node 338, always uses the template's fixed seed 42, exactly as in the official template). {{WIDTH}} into node 372 (PrimitiveInt 'Width') and {{HEIGHT}} into node 360 (PrimitiveInt 'Height'). {{FPS}} into node 361 (PrimitiveInt 'Frame Rate'). {{FRAMES}} into node 362 (PrimitiveInt 'Duration') - NOTE: in the official template this parameter is actually 'duration in seconds', not a raw frame count; the template itself computes the real frame length internally as duration*frame_rate+1 via node 378 (ComfyMathExpression). {{FILENAME_PREFIX}} into node 75 (SaveVideo). The audio branch (nodes 358 LTXVAudioVAEDecode, 366 LTXVEmptyLatentAudio, 340/377 LTXVConcatAVLatent, 367/369 LTXVSeparateAVLatent) is kept exactly as in the official template with its real (non-placeholder) values, even though VOXini does not yet use the AUDIO output, per instructions not to remove nodes from the middle of the graph. This workflow requires models from the GATED Hugging Face repo https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5 (the user must request/accept access there first): ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors (diffusion_models), gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors (text_encoders), ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors and ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors (vae), and ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors (latent_upscale_models, used by the template's built-in 2x latent upscale pass). A small non-gated prompt-enhancer text encoder (gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot.safetensors, from Comfy-Org/gemma-4) is also referenced by node 393 but is only actually loaded/used by ComfyUI if prompt_enhance (node 383) is set to true; it is left at the official default of false. UNVERIFIED / FLAGGED for human review: (1) [RESOLVED after cross-check against docs.comfy.org/built-in-nodes/LTXVDualCFGGuider] LTXVDualCFGGuider (nodes 391, 388) - the two numeric widgets (both value 1 in the official template) are confirmed to be 'video_cfg' and 'audio_cfg' (FLOAT, default 3.0/7.0 respectively when not overridden by the template) and have been corrected accordingly - initially guessed as 'cfg1'/'cfg2', now fixed. (2) TextGenerateLTX2Prompt (node 380, only exercised when prompt_enhance=true) has ~11 additional numeric/boolean widgets in the official template (values: '',600,'on',0.7,64,0.95,0.05,1.15,0,0,false,true) whose exact input key names could not be determined from the UI JSON and were left unset here (ComfyUI will use the node's own server-side defaults). (3) ComfyMathExpression's formula-string widget is emitted as 'expression' by best-effort naming (its values.a/values.b/values.c input names are confirmed directly from the source JSON). (4) CreateVideo (node 370) has a second widgets_values entry (8) in the source with no corresponding named input in the UI JSON; it was left out. None of these four items carry a {{...}} placeholder.
